Let  
\[
h(x)=e^x-\frac12x^2+1-x,\quad x\ge0.
\]
Then
\[
h'(x)=e^x-x-1\ge 0
\]
for \(x\ge0\), with equality only at \(x=0\). Thus \(h\) is increasing on \([0,\infty)\), so
\[
h(x)\ge h(0)=2>0.
\]
Hence \(|h(x)|=h(x)\), and the minimum distance is
\[
\min_{x_1\ge0} h(x_1)=h(0)=2.
\]
At \(x_1=0\), \(x_2=2>0\), so the configuration is valid.

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
